message:
Running command: cd /workspace && for f in /tmp/ex.jpg /workspace/pocs/img_im.jpg; do echo FILE:$f; identify "$f" >/tmp/iout 2>&1; echo exit:$?; cat /tmp/iout; done && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for n in [1,2,3]:
    b=Path(f'/workspace/pocs/cut_before_sos{n}.pdf').read_bytes()
    s=b.split(b'stream\n')[1].split(b'\nendstream')[0]
    Path(f'/workspace/pocs/cut{n}.jpg').write_bytes(s)
PY
for f in /workspace/pocs/cut1.jpg /workspace/pocs/cut2.jpg /workspace/pocs/cut3.jpg; do echo FILE:$f; identify "$f" >/tmp/iout 2>&1; echo exit:$?; head -20 /tmp/iout; done
